description: Exact algebra controls only. These records are not LMFDB objects and carry no claim about a genuine GL(2) L-function.

controls.label: SYNTHETIC_CONTROL
controls.purpose: The parity-forced simple zero is the entire central atom.

controls.label: SYNTHETIC_CONTROL
controls.purpose: Parity-only deflation leaves an exact residual atom of multiplicity two.

controls.label: SYNTHETIC_CONTROL
controls.purpose: A positive root number forces no zero, so sign-only deflation removes nothing.

controls.label: SYNTHETIC_HOSTILE_CONTROL
controls.purpose: Full deflation restores an indefinite background; deflation is bookkeeping, not a positivity theorem.

controls.label: SYNTHETIC_NEGATIVE_CONTROL
controls.expected_error: central-order parity is incompatible with the root number
